entities.name: Query protein
observations: 158 aa bacterial membrane protein; predicted molecular weight 17.62 kDa and pI 6.57.
Exact sequence match to UniProt Q4L5P8, a reviewed Staphylococcus haemolyticus lipoprotein signal peptidase.
77.8% identity over full query coverage to reviewed Staphylococcus aureus lipoprotein signal peptidases A7X1E3 and A6U115.
Annotated as a multi-pass cell/plasma-membrane protein that removes signal peptides from prolipoproteins.

entities.name: Q4L5P8
observations: Reviewed Staphylococcus haemolyticus lipoprotein signal peptidase; exact sequence match to the query.
Catalyzes removal of signal peptides from prolipoproteins.
Localized to the cell membrane and annotated as a multi-pass membrane protein.

entities.name: A7X1E3
observations: Reviewed Staphylococcus aureus lipoprotein signal peptidase with 77.8% identity and 100% query coverage to the query.
Catalyzes removal of signal peptides from prolipoproteins; localized to the cell membrane.

entities.name: Bacterial lipoprotein biosynthesis
observations: Lipoprotein signal peptidase activity contributes to protein modification and bacterial lipoprotein biosynthesis by cleaving prolipoprotein signal peptides.

entities.name: Lipoprotein signal peptidase function
observations: The protein is strongly supported as a bacterial lipoprotein signal peptidase: exact sequence match to Q4L5P8 and a matching Peptidase_A8 domain.
Associated Gene Ontology terms are plasma membrane localization, aspartic-type endopeptidase activity, and proteolysis.
